brief:
Israeli occupation forces took olive-picking equipment from residents in the Mugheir plain east of Ramallah, according to Maan Wire. The incident was captured on video showing the moment troops confiscated the harvest tools.

The seizure occurred in an agricultural area where Palestinians were engaged in seasonal olive harvesting. Israeli military operations in the region have previously disrupted Palestinian farming activities.
title: Israeli forces seize olive-harvesting equipment from Palestinians in Ramallah plains
